actions.title: General-ledger control variance against the stock schedule
actions.recommendedReview: Reconcile the general-ledger balance and the stock schedule behind this control account.
actions.limitations: Both sides of the comparison are valid data. The sign states which side carries more, not which side is wrong, and a variance is a finding to investigate rather than an error.

evidence.name: exception_detail
evidence.value: Used Vehicle Inventory at Granite Chevrolet of Nashua on date key 20250930: GL balance 758234.03 against subledger balance 756984.03, signed variance 1250.00. BOTH SIDES ARE VALID DATA. Positive means the control account carries more than the stock schedule supports; negative means the schedule carries more than the account. This is a reconciliation finding to investigate, not a broken record.

actions.title: Control account with one side of the comparison absent
actions.recommendedReview: Confirm which side of this control comparison is absent and reconcile it.
actions.limitations: A missing side is not a zero balance. The absent amount is carried as null and is never coalesced: "no balance was recorded" and "the balance was zero" are different control positions.

evidence.name: exception_detail
evidence.value: Certified Vehicle Inventory at Granite Subaru of Manchester on date key 20250831: the stock schedule carries 309189.63 over 20 unit(s) and NO control account balance exists to compare it against. The variance is NULL, not the full subledger balance: a missing balance is not a zeroed account.

actions.title: Control account with one side of the comparison absent
actions.recommendedReview: Confirm which side of this control comparison is absent and reconcile it.
actions.limitations: A missing side is not a zero balance. The absent amount is carried as null and is never coalesced: "no balance was recorded" and "the balance was zero" are different control positions.

evidence.name: exception_detail
evidence.value: New Vehicle Inventory at Granite Pre-Owned Center of Merrimack on date key 20251231: the control account carries 18400.00 and NO stock schedule exists to support it. The variance is NULL, not the full control balance: an absent schedule is not an empty one.
